title: I know we’re all excited about Megan, but I need to give some love to...
transcript: Okay, so here's the tea. Obviously everyone is going to see Moulin Rouge right now for Megan Thee Stallion. She just started her run as Zidler. It's very fun, but don't sleep on the cast around her, because I think the cast that they have assembled here is one of the best in the show's history. And they have brought in some real heavyweights. Kelsie Watts just joined the company as Satine, fresh off her run in six as Jane Seymour, and her voice is unreal. I think this might be one of the best vocal performances we've had in a Satine. Her acting is also really great, and she's one of the few satines that actually made me believe she was sick. She handles that gradual progression really well. As Christian, we have Christian Douglas, who literally feels like he was made in a lab to play this role. Vocally very similar to Aaron Tveit, and he nails the doe eyed naivete of the character. And then the supporting cast is like the Avengers of Moulin Rouge casts. We have Andre Ward and David Harris, both of whom originated their roles on the Moulin Rouge tour. We have Ricky Rojas, who originated his role in Boston and on Broadway. And then as Nini, we have Sarah Bowden, who played the role on the first national tour. So really, what I'm saying is, come for Megan Thee Stallion, but stay for the rest of the cast because they are firing on All cylinders
